text: On waking (tick ~1384), four HUD layers stack over the centre of the view: the E use-prompt, 'Click to look around', the controls hint box and WREN's subtitle. They don't overlap each other but together cover the porthole you are told to look out of. The controls hint and 'Click to look around' could sit lower/corner or appear after the subtitle.

At the probe console (tick ~6912), the 'Probe 2 m' waypoint marker sits on top of the use-reticle bracket and the console's own screen text (K-1 ready / ORPHEUS locked), right above the 'E Use the probe console' prompt. Once the use prompt shows, the waypoint marker is redundant and should hide.

After launching K-1 and pressing Esc at the probe console (tick 7563, screen CONSOLE->CUTSCENE, mode 'tweening'), the game froze for good: tick stuck at 7581, state.json not updated for 2+ minutes, screenshots byte-identical, Space/keys do nothing. No GPU process left in the Chrome tree and chrome.log shows a crashpad dump at 00:28:02. Machine load average was ~52, so this may be environment (SwiftShader GPU process dying) rather than game code, but a player would see a frozen frame with no error message.
